# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|----------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Fold14 MDD | **-9.31%** | -9.97% |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Observations

- **Champion retains crown**: Better tuning metrics and tighter drawdown control
- **Candidate trade-off**: Better lockbox minimum (robustness) but worse tail risk (MDD)
- **Pipeline health**: 234 loops over ~25h, ~23h remaining — on track
- **No stuck experiments**: INCONCLUSIVE queue is clear ✓

## Recommended Actions

The three suggested commands are appropriate. Execute in order:

```bash
# 1. Module-level optimization
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. System-level validation  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items

- Monitor `worst_mdd` on new candidates — the -11.18% on last PASS is close to typical rejection thresholds
- Tuning min of 0.051 on candidate suggests possible overfit to certain folds; worth investigating fold variance

Ready for next cycle. 🔄
